title: Free boundary problem for two-dimensional ElectroHydroDynamic Equations with a gravity field
summary: This paper studies a two-phase free boundary problem governed by the ElectroHydroDynamic equations, which describes a perfectly conducting, incompressible, irrotational fluid with gravity, surrounded by a dielectric gas. The interface separating fluid and gas is referred to as the free boundary. It is known that the free surface remains smooth away from the stagnation points, where the relative velocity of the incompressible fluid vanishes.
